task.title: Save real human replies and close consultations
task.input: M4-T3 operator authorization/reads and M4-T10 message append.
task.output: POST /api/admin/chat/conversations/[id]/messages and PATCH /api/admin/chat/conversations/[id]; current authors and close CAS.
task.accept: 1) Caller/wiring point: real ADMIN/SALES message handler -> current identity -> shared append. author comes from the session. Two concurrent people retain unique seq and their actual authors; same-UUID/payload retries create one message. Ignore client-claimed authors (E-33). 2) After a visitor POST persists, an operator GET actually reads it; after an operator POST replies, visitor GET reads the same body/author. No AI automatic reply is generated. received follows persistence (E-16, E-31). 3) Close uses expectedVersion CAS; only a matching contender succeeds. Closed visitor/operator sends return 409. After permission revocation, the next poll/send returns no body and causes no write. Modified threadId/seq/email cannot read someone else (E-32, E-78).
